meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 这个技能会先分析你 NanoClaw 分支里的自定义改动,写成一份可重放的迁移指南;升级时在干净的上游副本上按指南重放这些改动,替代 git merge。它只动代码,不碰数据目录。
howto.when: 当你准备把本地 NanoClaw 分支升级到上游、又不想用 git merge 处理冲突时触发;如果迁移指南已存在,会询问是否直接跳到升级。

say.text: 把我在这个分支上的自定义改动提取成迁移指南
say.note: Claude 会先检查工作区,再用子代理分析改动

say.text: 升级到上游,并用指南重放我改过的配置和技能
say.note: 会在临时工作区验证后再影响实际安装

say.text: 已有指南,直接跳到升级阶段
say.note: 有可用指南时可选,省去重新提取

howto.what_en: This skill analyzes your NanoClaw fork, turns user customizations into a replayable migration guide, then upgrades to upstream by reapplying them on a clean checkout, replacing merge-based upgrades. It touches code only, never data directories.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to upgrade a local NanoClaw fork to upstream without handling git merge conflicts. If a migration guide already exists, it offers to skip straight to the upgrade phase.

say_en.text: Turn my custom changes on this fork into a migration guide.
say_en.note: Checks the working tree, then analyzes changes with sub-agents.

say_en.text: Upgrade to upstream, reapplying my config and skill changes from the guide.
say_en.note: Validates in a temporary worktree before touching the live install.

say_en.text: I already have a guide, so skip to the upgrade phase.
say_en.note: Available when a guide exists; no re-extraction.
